description: Developed and delivered enterprise-grade IBM BPM / BAW solutions in the banking domain.

Optimized game performance to reduce load times and improve UX.

Integrated REST APIs and contributed to Bachat Mart, car pooling apps, TikTok-style feed cloning, and websites.
